scripts.dev: npm run build:worklet && npm run build:render-worker && concurrently -k -n worklet,render-worker,vite "vite build --config vite.worklet.config.ts --watch" "vite build --config vite.render-worker.config.ts --watch" "vite"
scripts.build: npm run build:worklet && npm run build:render-worker && vite build
scripts.build:lib: npm run build:worklet && npm run build:render-worker && vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json
